data.gender_notes: Jalbert is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic name Gisilberdus, meaning 'pledge, hostage, bright and shining'. In medieval Europe, names with 'ber' or 'bert' were popular among the nobility, representing strength and courage. The name Jalbert carries the meaning “Gisil- Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jalbert usually hope their child will grow to embody gisil- bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
